summary: Stores input SOP geometry over time for faster random-access playback and scrubbing of otherwise expensive SOP chains.

key_params.name: prefill
key_params.note: Fill the cache immediately with this many cooks

key_params.name: cachesize
key_params.note: Number of geometry states to store

key_params.name: outputindex
key_params.note: Cached geometry index to output; 0 is most recent

key_params.name: cachepoints
key_params.note: Cache one topology and only point data for later entries

key_params.name: blendpos
key_params.note: Interpolate point positions between cached geometries

common_gotchas: Output Index is valid from 0 to Cache Size minus 1; out-of-range indexing cannot retrieve older geometry.
Cache Points Only assumes topology is stable across cached entries.
Caching speeds playback after data is collected but increases memory use.
Prefill greater than zero fills the cache immediately and behaves as though Active is off.
A saved nonzero Prefill value will pre-fill again when the file is reopened.
key_concepts: Cache SOP stores SOP geometry states over time for random-access playback and scrubbing.
Output Index 0 is the newest cached geometry, with older entries addressed up to Cache Size minus one.
Point-only caching stores one topology and later point positions, so topology must stay stable.
Prefill can populate the cache immediately and has special behavior when opening saved files.
